general.summary: New Zealand investment firm Jarden says it will press ahead with its efforts to obtain cloned phone data and documents from two top executives defecting to rival Barrenjoey after its initial court application was dismissed.

general.title: Former E*Trade CEO on Private Markets, Rise of AI
general.summary: Mitch Caplan, former CEO of E*Trade Financial and current head of Willow Wealth, joined the program to discuss recent market fluctuations and their impact on retail investors. He provided insights into how individual investors tend to react during periods of market uncertainty and volatility. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: 2026 Best Cities for Work Revealed
general.summary: Indeed Hiring Lab measured 40 metrics across six pillars against hundreds of US metro-areas to determine which cities are the best for workers in 2026. Laura Ullrich, Director of Economic Research at Indeed Hiring Lab, explains that its not about where company's are headquartered or where its best to run a company, but where Indeed is seeing the most career dynamism and opportunity -- so the top cities for workers may surprise you. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: How LeBron James Scored $300 Million From Insurers
general.summary: When LeBron James signed up to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to NBA glory with a $154 million contract in 2018, it wasn’t the biggest deal he did that year. His limited liability company borrowed almost $300 million from two Midwestern life insurers, Sridhar Natarajan explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: AI Trade at Risk From US Voter Ire Over Buildout, Barclays Says
general.summary: The relentless buildout of artificial intelligence infrastructure is drawing bipartisan backlash, which could introduce political risk to the market’s beloved trade ahead of the US midterm election.

general.title: Northrop CEO on Defense Spending, Golden Dome System
general.summary: Northrop Grumman Chair, CEO and President Kathy Warden discusses doing business with the Trump administration, working on the Golden Dome space defense system and how geopolitical tensions and active conflicts are fueling a global defense spending boom. She speaks with Bloomberg's Kailey Leinz at a Newsmakers event in Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Conference Board CEO: Consumers Worried About the Future
general.summary: Steve Odland, CEO of The Conference Board, discussed the recent consumer confidence data showing a significant divergence between current sentiment and future expectations. The present situation index increased by 6.8 points, reflecting consumers' relatively positive feelings due to full employment and rising wages. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: The Mormon Church Is Putting Its Real Estate Empire to Work
general.summary: After decades of quietly amassing billions of dollars in land, the institution is investing in more deals and planning massive projects that stand to reshape communities. Bloomberg's Natalie Wong, Ann Choi and Katie Meyer explain. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: BOK to Weigh Back-to-Back Hike as Growth, Inflation Remain Firm
general.summary: The Bank of Korea’s policy decision this week is likely to go down to the wire, with a slim majority of economists expecting authorities to raise interest rates for a second straight meeting as they seek to stay ahead of stronger-than-expected growth and persistent underlying inflation.

general.title: Dick's Sporting Goods stock falls 30% as retailer misses expectations, cites 'challenging' footwear market
general.summary: Dick's Sporting Goods reported fiscal second-quarter earnings on Tuesday that missed Wall Street expectations amid what it called a "challenging" environment.

general.title: Zoom Gives Lukewarm Outlook Despite Expanded Product Line
general.summary: Zoom Communications Inc. gave a sales outlook for the current quarter that was about in line with analysts’ estimates, disappointing investors hoping for a greater uplift from its expanded suite of products.

general.title: Northrop CEO Expects ‘Decent Share’ of Golden Dome Contracts
general.summary: Northrop Grumman Corp. Chief Executive Officer Kathy Warden said the Trump administration’s Golden Dome space defense system was becoming “very tangible” for defense contractors and that her company will end up with a “decent share” of a program that may eventually cost more than $1 trillion.

general.title: Bitcoin Tops $80K as Bullish Mood Returns to Crypto Market
general.summary: Bloomberg's Isabelle Lee joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Bitcoin briefly climbed above $80,000 for the first time since mid-May, as optimism returns to the beaten-down crypto market amid a confluence of bullish signals that forced the liquidation of billions in leveraged bets. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: CBDC's Wrong Way To Fight The Dollar: Levin
general.summary: Bloomberg Opinion's Jonathan Levin joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Short Squeeze in US Long Bonds Shows ‘Bessent Put’ at Work
general.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s surprise plan to tamp down US borrowing costs by expanding bond buybacks may have sparked fierce debate about its ultimate effectiveness, but key market metrics and positioning show that it’s having an impact.

general.title: Canada Is Hitting Hundreds of US-Made Items With Tariffs: Read the List
general.summary: Canada will place counter-tariffs on more than 700 products made in the US as retaliation for a new set of import taxes by the White House.

general.title: IMF Chief Urges Governments to Tackle Rising Fiscal Risks
general.summary: As the global economy faces mounting pressures, International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva urged governments to address growing fiscal challenges and central bankers to stay committed to lowering inflation.

general.title: Apple’s next chapter: 3 pressing challenges facing Tim Cook’s successor as CEO
general.summary: John Ternus will assume the CEO role on Sept. 1, inheriting the tech giant at a pivotal moment.

general.summary: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.

general.title: UK Household Inflation Worries Pick Up Again in August
general.summary: Inflation fears among UK households jumped again in August, a resurgence that will worry Bank of England officials amid little sign of a resolution to the US-Iran conflict.
